B:
paṇihita： paṇihita（ti）
ပဏိဟိတ（တိ）
[pa+ni+dhā+ta．pa-saddo pakārādikamma．．．patthanādīsu．．．．patthane paṇihitaṃ．rū，nhā-126．nidhīyitthāti nihito ]]kvaci dhātū]] tiādinā dhissa hi tappaccaye．evaṃ vihito．rū．633．dhāssahi．．．．nihitoç nihitavā．，5．108．（-pāṇini．7，4，42．kātanta，．78）．（praṇihita-saṃ．paṇihiya-prā）]
[ပ+နိ+ဓာ+တ။ ပ-သဒေ္ဒါ ပကာရာဒိကမ္မ．．．ပတ္ထနာဒီသု။．．．ပတ္ထနေ ပဏိဟိတံ။ ရူ၊ နှာ-၁၂၆။ နိဓီယိတ္ထာတိ နိဟိတော ＂ကွစိ ဓာတူ＂ တိအာဒိနာ ဓိဿ ဟိ တပ္ပစ္စယေ။ ဧဝံ ဝိဟိတော။ ရူ။ ၆၃၃။ ဓာဿဟိ။ ．．．နိဟိတော，နိဟိတဝါ။ မောဂ်၊ ၅။ ၁၀၈။ （-ပါဏိနိ။ ၇၊ ၄၊ ၄၂။ ကာတန္တ၊ ကိတ်။ ၇၈）။ （ပြဏိဟိတ-သံ။ ပဏိဟိယ-ပြာ）]
C: paṇihita：[pp．of paṇidahati] aspired to； longed for； put forth； directed； bent on； intent．
P: Paṇihita，[pp．of paṇidahati] applied，directed，intent，bent on，well directed，controlled S．IV，309 （dup°）； A．I，8； V，87； Dh．43； （sammā °ṁ cittaṁ）； Sn．154 （su° mano= suṭṭhu ṭhapito acalo SnA 200）； Ps．II，41 （vimokkha）； Miln．204，333； 413．--appaṇihita in connection with samādhi & vimokkha seems to mean “free from all longings，” see Vin．III，93=IV．25； S．IV，295，309，360； Ps．II，43 sq．，100； Miln．337．（Page 403）
U: PAṆIHITA：（pp của paṇidahati） được hướng dẫn，nghiêng về，cố ý

DOP: paṇidahati paṇidheti pr. 3 sg. [ S., BHS praṇidadhāti, BHS also praṇidheti], directs, fixes; places, positions, disposes; aspires to; makes a resolution or earnest wish; M III 196, 27 (appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ ~ati); S I 133, 14* (tattha cittaṃ paṇidhehi); IV 303, 19 (sace ~issati anāgataṃ addhānaṃ rājā assaṃ cakkavattī ti ijjhissati); Nidd I 79, 20 (tassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ ~ati mā maṃ jaññā ti icchati); Mil 129, 18 foll. (paṇidhehi mārisa amukassa kulassa mahesiyā kucchin ti so tassa āyācanahetu taṃ kulaṃ paṇidheti); Vv-a 332, 11 (tumhe … tatrūpapattiyā cittaṃ ~athā ti); — part.pr. ( a ) paṇidaha(t), mfn. , S V 156, 5 ; Pj II 49, 15 ; ( b ) paṇidahanta, mfn. , Kv 343, 29 ; Ps I 34, 9 ; — neg. a(p)ppaṇidahanta, mfn. , Kv 343, 25 ; — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) paṇidahī, Mhv 5:54; ( b ) paṇidhesi, Pj II 49, 7 (so hi Dīpaṅkaraṃ sammukhā disvā paṇidhesi); Ap-a 364, 15 (santipadaṃ paṇidhesi); 2 sg. paṇidahi, Ja VI 299, 28* (mā h’ ev’ adhammesu manaṃ paṇīdahi, mc; 300, 6´ : mā … tava cittaṃ ~ī ti); 1 sg. paṇidahiṃ, S V 156, 9 ; Ap 544, 8 (taṃ ṭhānaṃ paṇipacca ~iṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be paṇīdahiṃ, mc ); — absol. ( a ) paṇidhāya ( and occasionally panidhāya), fixing, directing; positioning, disposing; aspiring (to); with the aspiration …; making for, headed to; Vin III 100, 35 (aññataro bhikkhu paṇidhāya araññe viharati evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī ti; Sp 502, 22 : patthanaṃ katvā); D I 71, 19 (pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya; Sv 210, 21 foll.: uparimaṃ sarīraṃ ujukaṃ ṭhapetvā); M I 74, 15 (puriso āgaccheyya … ekāyanena maggena tam eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya; Ps II 38, 4 foll.: aṅgārakāsuyaṃ patthanā nāma natthi, aṅgārakāsuṃ ārabbha pana iriyāpathassa ṭhapitattā evaṃ vuttaṃ); 102, 9 (bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati); S I 42, 24* (vācaṃ manaṃ ca paṇidhāya sammā); V 157, 22 (desitā mayā paṇidhāya bhāvanā desitā apaṇidhāya bhāvanā; cf Spk III 206, 6 foll. ); Mil 1, 11* (tattha ñāṇaṃ paṇidhāya); — neg. apaṇidhāya, S V 157, 1 ; ( b ) paṇidhitvā, Ap 342, 13 (tattha cittaṃ paṇidhitvā); — pp paṇihita , mfn. [ S. praṇihita], directed; placed, positioned, disposed; aspired to, aimed at; characterised by desire or purpose; D II 292, 15 (yathā yathā vā pan’ assa kāyo ~o hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti; Sv 768, 15 : yena yena vā ākāren’ assa kāyo ṭhito hoti); A I 171, 16 (imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā ~ā); Ja V 368, 6* (khiḍḍā ~ā tyāsu; 368, 23´ : tāsu itthīsu kāyavacīkhiḍḍā ca ~ā ohitā ṭhapitā); Ap 381, 23 (sakkā uddharituṃ attā yassa cittaṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se sunīhitaṃ); Paṭis II 35, 28 (~o vimokkho; Paṭis-a 552, 31 : ~o ti taṇhāvasena ~o patthito); 41, 11 (cattāri jhānāni catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo ayaṃ ~o vimokkho; Paṭis-a 559, 2 : taṇhāya ālambito ~o anālambito appaṇihito); Vibh 252, 10 (ujuko hoti kāyo ṭhito ~o); Sv 975, 28 (yo yassa iriyāpatho manussaloke ~o ahosi); Paṭis-a 276, 29 (nikantipanidhiyā hi ~aṃ patthitan ti attho tadabhāvena appaṇihitaṃ); — ifc see micchā-, yathā-, sammā-; — neg. appaṇihita ( and apaṇihita), mfn. [ BHS apraṇihita], not fixed, not directed; characterised by the absence of desire or purpose or aim; Vin III 92, 37 (suññato vimokkho animitto vimokkho appaṇihito vimokkho); S IV 295, 14 (saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ … bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti suññato phasso animitto phasso appaṇihito phasso ti); V 157, 2 (bahiddhā … bhikkhu cittaṃ apaṇidhāya apaṇihitaṃ me bahiddhā cittan ti pajānāti); Nidd I 373, 29 (appaṇihitena pi jhānena jhāyī); Paṭis II 36, 14 (suññaṃ idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā ti so tattha paṇidhiṃ na karoti appaṇihito vimokkho); 41, 13 (cattāro ca ariyamaggā cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni nibbānaṃ ca, ayaṃ appaṇihito vimokkho); 66, 17 (yato muccati tattha na paṇidahatī ti appaṇihito vimokkho; Paṭis-a 568, 16 : tasmiṃ nimitte patthanaṃ na karoti); Dhs 351 (paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati appaṇihitaṃ); Nett 90, 13 (dosacarito puggalo appaṇihitena vimokkhamukhena niyyāti); Mil 337, 6 (appaṇihito samādhi); Vism 669, 12 foll. (dukkhānupassanā saṅkhāresu paṇidhiṃ sukkhāpetvā āgatattā appaṇihitā nāma, appaṇihitavipassanāya maggo appaṇihito appaṇihitamaggassa phalaṃ appaṇihitaṃ); Sv 1004, 8 foll. (vipassanā appaṇihitā nāma hoti, kasmā, paṇidhikārakakilesābhāvā); Dhp-a II 172, 12 (nibbānaṃ … rāgādipaṇidhīnaṃ pana abhāvena appaṇihitaṃ tehi ca vimuttan ti appaṇihito vimokkho ti vuccati); — appaṇihito in Ee at It-a II 36, 26 is wr for apanīto ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — duppaṇihita, mfn. , wrongly directed; with a wrong aim; S IV 309, 5 (tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe gahitaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ ime sattā haññantu …; Spk III 103, 24 : duṭṭhu ṭhapitaṃ); — su(p)paṇihita, mfn. , properly directed; well-disposed; properly positioned; M I 323, 22 (suppaṇihitaṃ me mānasaṃ saccānaṃ bodhāyā ti); Sn 154 (mano supaṇihito … sabbabhūtesu); Paṭis I 176, 28 (ujuko hoti kāyo ṭhito supaṇihito, Be, Ee so; Ce paṇihito; Se paṇidhito paṇihito); Ap 75, 21 (mānasaṃ suppaṇīhitaṃ, Be, Ce so, mc; Ee, Se suppaṇihitaṃ); — fpp paṇidahitabba, mfn. , S V 156, 4 ; Kv-a 65, 12 (paṇidahitabbaṭṭhena paṇidhī ti).
